name: MarketerHire
summary: Hire pre-vetted expert marketing talent on demand: growth marketers, paid ads specialists, email pros and more — matched to your business within days.
best_for: companies that need a vetted senior marketer (growth, paid ads, email, more) matched quickly, without the time and risk of a full-time hire
skip_if: you need cheap, task-level help (a freelance marketplace fits) or you can't yet brief and direct a senior marketer toward a clear goal
honest_knock: This is vetted senior freelance talent on a monthly retainer with no published rates — the value is speed and vetting (the pricing page promises a match within 24-48 hours, against a months-long hire), and the budget is whatever you agree on the call. Because it's talent, not software, outcomes depend on the individual and how well you brief them; the two-week refundable trial and rematch help, but you still own the strategy. Right when a great marketer would pay for themselves, wrong as a budget stopgap.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-23 against marketerhire.com/pricing and the vendor's FAQ at marketerhire.com/faqs/all) No rates are published on the pricing page or in the FAQ. The pricing page says there is "no plan to pick and no retainer to guess at" and that after one call you are matched with a marketer "at a budget you agreed to". Published terms: a free consultation with no obligation, a match within 24-48 hours, a two-week refundable trial, and month-to-month billing you can cancel at any time. The FAQ adds how it works: engagements are structured as a monthly retainer, with the marketer working to agreed priorities and outcomes instead of tracked hours; you are billed at project kick-off; if the first person does not work out during the initial two weeks you are rematched with another candidate, as part of the Service Contract signed at the start; invoices are monthly and can be reviewed before they are processed, by card or ACH. The hiring form routes you by budget, either to a call with a Growth Manager or to a further job brief with a follow-up.

cost_traps.label: Quote-only pricing
cost_traps.evidence: No rates published; matched to a marketer 'at a budget you agreed to' after a call, billed as a monthly retainer (re-verified 23 Sep 2026)

compare_with.name: Upwork/Toptal or a marketing agency
compare_with.why: raw freelance marketplaces are cheaper but unvetted; agencies bundle teams — MarketerHire's edge is fast, pre-vetted individual senior talent
